Very comfortable and clean stay! Would recommend!!
Jun 2017 • Couples
We arrived at nha trang at 6am and had noticed funny house on booking.com due to its good price and reviews! After a coffee we headed to funny house at 7am, not expecting to be able to check in until 2pm. We were overjoyed that the lady owner allowed us to access to a room to be able to shower before we could check in, especially after we'd been on a night bus from hoi an! After a trip to the beach (which is only a 5 minute walk away) we checked into our room, it was extremely clean and smelt amazing!! The room facilities were great for the money - very good air conditioning/ a fan, a kitchen area, fridge, good tv, free toiletries and hairdryer! We slept very well with comfy beds and nice pillow/duvet! The breakfast was good and the coffe is to die for! The cafe below gets busy with locals in the morning which is a testament to the niceness of this place :) helpful owners and staff (they helped booked our bus to dalat). We were very pleased with our stay and would happily return!!

Good common area
Aug 2016 • Couples
It's easy to find a  decent 10$ hotel in Nha Trang, and most of them are of the same standard; tall, narrow buildings with ok rooms. Sometimes there's a fridge, sometimes a bathtub.

Funny House has something most places lack, a good hang-out area with pub and resturant (popular among Nha Trang workers in the morning)

Good service (by cute waitressess) and super helpful management.

Funny House's rooms are pretty standard, but rather spacious and the bed was great. I think there are 7 rooms, we had the one on the top floor which was very quiet. 

Not super-close to bar street or the beach, but perfectly walkable.
